description: Both jobs run in a container, and the container is `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python` — Python's Playwright, one path segment past the image this gate reads. It is a real image with real browsers, and it is not the one whose tag the lockfile can hold: its version follows the Python package, which this repository does not have. So it is no installation here, and with no step beside it the workflow installs nothing. The edge is the character after `playwright`: a reader that matched the repository as a prefix would take this for the image and pass.
ciText:
jobs:
  gates:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected -t lint test build check-browsers
  e2e:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }} -t e2e
